Settings

Students who are not covered and who have a priority ranking above this number will not trigger Individual* students being grouped.
Heterogeneous = groups mix high- and low-priority students.
Homogeneous = groups students with similar priority together.
Yes = when two or more staff are available, prefer staff with fewer current assignments.
No = assign based off availability and order/ranking.
Yes = show issue/status badges in the managers and schedule editor.
No = hide badges by default.
Blank or 0 = no global override. Any positive value overrides student-specific grouping limits during Periods 1–6 and Break.
Blank or 0 = no global override. Any positive value overrides student-specific grouping limits during break/lunch coverage. To prevent grouping for a specific student during break/lunch coverage, set that student's Max Group Size to 0 in Student Manager.
Yes = for break/lunch coverage, students remain blocked from specific staff as indicated.
No = for break/lunch coverage, students are NOT blocked and can be supported by any staff.
Yes = when students remain uncovered after the normal schedule and break process, staff marked as being interested in overtime will be scheduled without a lunch break.
No = staff overtime interest will not be used as a potential option to improve scheduling shortfalls.
Yes = if a staff break/lunch cannot be covered by a truly free staff member, allow direct same-location temporary grouping for that rest window only. If direct grouping cannot solve the rest need, protected Lead coverage may be used, and daisy-chain is only considered as a final pass after all non-daisy options fail. Options are scored to avoid disrupting lower numeric priority students whenever possible.
Yes = Behavior Interventionists may be used as fallback for Instruction support and for break/lunch coverage of Instruction needs. Exact Behavior matches are still prioritized first.
Yes = Special Education Assistants may be used as fallback for Behavior support and for break/lunch coverage of Behavior needs. Exact Behavior Interventionist matches are still prioritized first.
Controls which newer schedule choke points are flagged in managers and Logic Review.
Enter one or more email addresses. Separate with commas, semicolons, spaces, or line breaks. These addresses are notified when a staff absence report is submitted.
Optional. Automatically publishes the current working schedule before the workday starts.
Optional. Clears the current staff-facing published schedule after the school day ends.
Immediately removes the current staff-facing published schedule. Historical snapshots remain saved.
Run a quick database check. Use Stabilize Database once to clear sheet validation rules and add missing stable IDs for staff/students.
Generate one letter per active staff member for this school with their personal Staff Portal and app-pairing QR codes.
Open the underlying database spreadsheet for direct edits. Use carefully; changes here bypass portal validation.
